import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(0)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return
    
    ages = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    
    actual_sum = sum(ages)
    binary_sum = sum(int(bin(age)[2:], 2) for age in ages)
    
    deviation = abs(binary_sum - actual_sum)
    print(deviation)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
